text:
morgan: heads up — planning a small RBAC change for the image-signer job. goal: grant minimal KMS operator permissions to the signer pod so it can sign during the base-image rebuild. want security + infra eyes before we prod-roll. :eyes:

Dina: ok. can you paste the exact IAM/KMS policy you intend to apply? want to check for over-privilege.

morgan: sure — draft below. trying to scope to single key ARN + allow crypto.sign only.

morgan: ```json
{
  \"Role\": \"projects/redwood-prod/roles/kmsImageSigner\",
  \"Permissions\": [\"cloudkms.cryptoSign\"],
  \"Resource\": \"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-key\"
}
```

lee: that looks fine at a glance. two quick asks: 1) ensure the role cannot list keys in other keyRings, 2) add condition to restrict access only from the signer SA via iam.condition if supported.

sam: also think about short-lived credentials — can the signer pod use Workload Identity / IAM binding so we can revoke quickly? avoid long-lived service-account tokens.

morgan: yes using GKE Workload Identity. binding will be `signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/kmsImageSigner` with condition `attribute.service_account == signer-sa` in IAM.

Dina: audit question: will signing events land in Cloud Audit Logs with the signer principal? we need to ensure key usage shows operator and repo/tag metadata.

audit-bot: cloud-audit: CryptoKeyAccess events will be logged for crypto.sign operations. include label propagation by adding `x-image` and `build_id` to the signing request metadata — make sure signer code sets `additionalAuthenticatedData` (AAD) when calling KMS.

morgan: noted. signer PR will attach AAD: `{"image":"base-ubuntu-2026-03","build_id":"BR-1234"}`.

lee: for runtime hardening — plan to run signer in a minimal scratch container and enable seccomp + read-only rootfs. also drop NET_RAW, SYS_PTRACE capabilities.

sam: agree. add an init container that validates presence of KMS credential token and fails fast if missing. reduces silent mis-signs.

morgan: rollout plan: canary 5% of rebuild jobs for next 48h, monitor audit logs & cosign attestations. if any signer errors -> fallback to previous offline-sign process.

Dina: who owns the fallback? need oncall contact. also add an alert for >1 failed sign per hour from signer-sa.

morgan: owner: @morgan, backup: @lee. I'll add alert in ops - `signer.sign.failures > 1/1h => pager`.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: signer-deploy v2 submitted (PR #4123). canary assignment: namespace `rebuild-canary` -> 3 replicas.

sam: quick vuln triage: the base image rebuild will pull in newer glibc. please run our vuln-scan pipeline on canary artifacts and post the SBOM link here.

morgan: will attach SBOM and vuln scan to the PR. expected schedule: canary today 17:00 UTC, full roll 48h later if green.

Dina: LGTM pending small IAM condition change (restrict to signer service account email). once PR updated I will sign off. :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks — updating PR now. tagging ops for alert creation and security for final audit signoff.

lee: one more: add cosign key transparency log entry and keep offline key escrow for emergency rollbacks.

morgan: noted. I'll add TL log step and a runbook for rollbacks.

Dina: add a short postmortem template to PR in case we have to roll back — helps capture timeline and audit records.

morgan: added checklist to PR. thanks everyone.

sam: :rocket:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 1745551600 — 3 pods in `rebuild-canary`.

morgan: closing thread, will reopen if issues crop up.
